notes: Original benchmark uses Highway VQPartialSort, not std::sort.
The two algorithms operate on the same original 11-bit-id packed double keys.
Only finite float inputs are tested, including many exact ties.
Synthetic leaf rows, not actual PiPNN graph candidate pools.
Benchmarked selected rows on one core, not full 4-thread ANN BUILD.
Any speedup from streaming top-2 is a baseline optimization, not novelty.
